Metadata.title: AgeClarity — understand a PhenoAge estimate
Metadata.description: A transparent, privacy-first calculator for exploring the PhenoAge estimate from nine laboratory biomarkers.

hero.eyebrow: A CLEARER READ OF YOUR LAB RESULTS
hero.title: Your lab results, with more context.
hero.body: Explore a PhenoAge estimate based on a published model. Clear about the calculation, units, and limitations.
hero.visualTitle: From your results to a clear explanation

intro.title: An information tool, not a diagnosis.
intro.body: Enter your age and the nine biomarkers used by the model. You can review the units and method before you begin.

calculator.title: Calculate an estimate
calculator.subtitle: You will need your age and exact results from a laboratory report.
calculator.ageBody: Use your age in completed years. We do not need your date of birth.
calculator.chemistryBody: Copy each value as it appears on your report and select its unit.
calculator.bloodBody: The model requires all nine biomarkers. We do not estimate missing values.
calculator.ageHelp: The model’s operating range is 20 to 84 years, inclusive.

hints.crp: Must be a measured value above zero. Do not enter results such as “< 0.3”.
hints.labUnit: Select the unit shown on your report. Units are never converted silently.

errors.required: Enter the value exactly as it appears on your report.
errors.age: Enter a whole-number age from 20 to 84 years.
errors.positive: Enter a finite number greater than zero.
errors.crp: CRP must be greater than zero. We cannot calculate from a censored result such as “< 0.3”.
errors.summary: Review the highlighted fields to continue.

result.title: Your PhenoAge estimate
result.methodNote: This difference is a mathematical output of the model. It is not a pace of ageing and does not establish a cause.
result.disclaimer: This is a population-level estimate, not a diagnosis, life-expectancy prediction, or definitive measure of biological age. Do not make health decisions based on this result.
result.readingBody: The estimate combines your age with the nine values you entered. The difference compares two calculated ages; it does not classify your health as good or bad.
result.readingLimit: Use it to understand the method and prepare questions, alongside your laboratory's ranges and context.
result.question1: How should these results be read in light of my history and my laboratory's reference ranges?
result.question2: Should any result be confirmed or reviewed before drawing conclusions?
result.reviewTitle: Review the 10 inputs used in the calculation
result.reviewBody: These values are converted to the units used by the formula. Check them against your lab report.
result.reviewCaution: We only check format, age range, and supported units; we do not assess laboratory accuracy or the clinical relevance of each value.
result.reportTitle: Want to learn more about the method?
result.reportBody: Extended reports and email delivery are not enabled in this version. Your data is not saved or sent.

interest.title: Get a notice when reports are available
interest.body: If you want to hear about future extended reports, leave your email. Only your address and consent are sent; your biomarkers and this result stay on your device. There is no PDF or payment yet.
interest.consent: I agree that AgeClarity may save my email to confirm this request and notify me when reports are available. I can withdraw consent by replying to the message.
interest.success: Request received. Check your email for a confirmation. We did not receive your lab results.
interest.error: We could not save your request. Please try again later.

privacy.title: Your lab results stay on this device.
privacy.body: The calculator runs the model in your browser. We do not upload or save your results, ask for an account, or use analytics to collect health data.
privacy.emailBody: The email notice is optional. If requested, we store your address, language, date, and consent version for up to 90 days in Supabase; Resend sends the confirmation and the owner receives an alert with your address, without lab results. You can request deletion by replying. We do not use your address for marketing.
privacy.note: Closing or reloading this page clears the values you entered.

method.title: A published model, explained with care.
method.body: PhenoAge combines chronological age and nine biomarkers through a deterministic equation. AgeClarity converts supported units and applies the documented coefficients; it does not use AI to calculate your result.
method.limitsTitle: What this result cannot tell you
method.limits: The original validation was conducted primarily in a United States population. We do not assume local calibration for Peru, Mexico, Spain, Brazil, or other countries. The gap is not a cause, personal prediction, or pace of ageing. Missing values are not imputed.
method.constant: The primary estimate uses the 0.090165 constant specified in this package. A historical 0.09165 variant is retained as a sensitivity scenario and does not change the primary result. External scientific verification of this discrepancy is still pending.

faq.title: Before you begin
faq.a1: It is a published phenotypic estimate combining chronological age and nine biomarkers. It describes a population-level mathematical association; it does not measure a true biological age.
faq.q2: What if my report says “less than”?
faq.a2: Do not enter an approximate value. The calculator does not impute censored results; ask your laboratory or a health professional how to interpret it.
faq.q3: Does a higher result mean I have a disease?
faq.a3: No. This tool does not diagnose, detect, or rule out disease. Talk with a health professional about your lab results.
faq.a4: Biomarkers and the result remain only in this page's memory and are discarded on reload. If you request an email notice, we save your address and consent separately.

footer.tagline: Clarity about the method. Care with conclusions.
footer.disclaimer: Educational tool. It does not replace a consultation with a health professional.
